applies_why: The judge text uses Matthew 1:18, Matthew 1:25 and Luke 1:34 as witnesses against the challenger's link, which is the kind of verse-as-witness counting that K-G4 governs, though no 'cited in' line is labelled.
quote: [L1] Matthew 1:18 "before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost" and Matthew 1:25 "knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son" contradict C3's claim of espousal union
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round
room: The phrase 'cited in' line is not present in the judge text, so I had to decide whether the rule governs verses listed under links; I weighed reading it as applying to any verse counted as a witness (yes) against reading it as inapplicable because no cited-in line is labelled (no).
why: The judge counts these verses as contradicting C3 and names no round and quotes no earlier-round sentence pressing them against the link, which the rule requires before a verse counts as an unanswered witness.
